_meta.source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, per-target GIS shapefile downloads (regenerated nightly)
_meta.notes: Maps data/gazetteer.json fields to display info, same convention as exoplanet-column-map.json and asteroid-column-map.json. `category` groups fields in detail views/column pickers. `precision` is a suggested decimal-place count. `nullLabel` is what to show when a value is missing. No siConversion/errorFields here — diameter is already in km (no unit conversion needed) and the Gazetteer doesn't publish measurement uncertainty for feature coordinates/sizes. `continent_code` and `ethnicity_code` are raw USGS abbreviation codes (e.g. for computing international-representation stats) — their full meaning requires a separate USGS abbreviations lookup table that hasn't been built into this site yet; treat these two fields as raw/unexplained for now, shown as-is rather than translated.
_meta.verification_note: Field presence was confirmed against USGS's field DEFINITIONS (planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Page/Specifics), not against an actually-opened shapefile's literal attribute keys (see fetch-gazetteer-data.js header). Run the fetch script once, check its console output against this file, and adjust nullLabel/tooltip coverage if any field consistently comes back empty for a body that should have it.

clean_name.label: Feature Name
clean_name.tooltip: Official IAU-approved name, shown without diacritical marks (which can cause display issues in some contexts). The properly-spelled form with diacritics, where different, is available on the detail page.

feature_name.label: Feature Name (full spelling)
feature_name.tooltip: The feature's name as spelled by the honoree or reference source, including diacritical marks.

target.label: Target Body
target.tooltip: The planet, moon, dwarf planet, or asteroid this feature is located on.

body_type.label: Body Type
body_type.tooltip: Planet, dwarf planet, moon, or asteroid — site-added classification (not part of the Gazetteer's own data) used to group the target picker.

feature_type.label: Feature Type
feature_type.tooltip: The descriptor term for this kind of feature (e.g. crater, mons, chasma, planitia) — a controlled vocabulary of Latin/Greek terms the IAU uses to classify surface feature types.

feature_type_code.label: Feature Type Code
feature_type_code.tooltip: USGS's short internal code paired with the feature type descriptor term. Not yet translated to a full label on this site.

center_lat.label: Center Latitude
center_lat.tooltip: Latitude of the feature's center point, in the IAU-approved coordinate system for this body (planetocentric, east longitude, per USGS's shapefile convention).

center_lon.label: Center Longitude
center_lon.tooltip: East longitude of the feature's center point, in the IAU-approved coordinate system for this body.

min_lat.label: Southern Bound
min_lat.tooltip: Southernmost latitude of the feature's extent.

max_lat.label: Northern Bound
max_lat.tooltip: Northernmost latitude of the feature's extent.

min_lon.label: Western Bound
min_lon.tooltip: Westernmost east-longitude of the feature's extent.

max_lon.label: Eastern Bound
max_lon.tooltip: Easternmost east-longitude of the feature's extent.

diameter_km.label: Diameter
diameter_km.tooltip: Approximate size of the feature across its widest extent.

origin.label: Name Origin
origin.tooltip: Who or what the feature is named after — e.g. a scientist, explorer, or figure from mythology, per the naming theme established for this body/feature type.

continent_code.label: Continent Code
continent_code.tooltip: USGS's raw abbreviation for the honoree's continent of origin, used internally to track international representation in naming. Not yet translated to a full label on this site.

ethnicity_code.label: Ethnic/Cultural Group Code
ethnicity_code.tooltip: USGS's raw abbreviation for the honoree's ethnic/cultural group or country, used internally to track international representation in naming. Not yet translated to a full label on this site.

approval_status.label: Approval Status
approval_status.tooltip: Whether this name is currently adopted by the IAU. This site only displays currently-adopted names — dropped or never-approved names are filtered out at fetch time.

approval_date.label: Approval Date
approval_date.tooltip: Date the name was formally approved by the IAU Working Group for Planetary System Nomenclature.

quad.label: Map Quadrangle
quad.tooltip: The informal name of the reference map this feature's coordinates were taken from.

quad_code.label: Map Quadrangle Code
quad_code.tooltip: USGS's short code for the reference map this feature's coordinates were taken from.

detail_url.label: Official USGS Record
detail_url.tooltip: Direct link to this feature's official page in the Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature.
